description: This file contains API functions related to user data and costs, providing functions for fetching user info, projects, session details, and LLM costs via HTTP API calls.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression; used for formatting timestamps in query parameters.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user document by ID from the /api/users/{id} endpoint.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches distinct projects for a user, with optional time range and tenant scoping, converting date params to Mongo-style ISODate format.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated session details (total count and duration) for a specified user.

methods.name: getLlmCostsByOrganization({ organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches LLM costs data for an organization, with pagination options.

ctags.name: getLlmCostsByOrganization
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getLlmCostsByOrganization({ organization_id, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {}) /
